fusions.name: Leaping Latch
fusions.desc: You leap up to 7 tiles onto the target and latch on with a strike that deals 12 damage, leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Host to Host
fusions.desc: Flicks a barb that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then jumps to 2 more within 3 tiles for 50% of that.

fusions.name: Bound Within Reach
fusions.desc: Springs you to a point up to 8 tiles away, with +10% dodge chance.

fusions.name: Latched Feeder
fusions.desc: When you strike an enemy, you heal for 15% of the damage you deal for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
